text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Apologies for bothering you, Trainer, but have you seen any ladybugs around?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. Seven-spotted ladybugs, to be precise. The ones that should be in the field at the moment have gone missing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: As one entrusted with their management, I am investigating their whereabouts.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, but it's more of a personal hobby.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Any information would be most appreciated, as I have no leads at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After splitting up and asking around the school, we get some useful information. We immediately head out to find the ladybugs, but…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez! Sit still already! How are you so tiny yet so fast?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Listen up, ladybugs! You'd better stay in the magic circle if you know what's good for you!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You there! Unhand those poor creatures!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wh-who're you?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We are members of the Ladybug Management Association. Return the ladybugs you abducted.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No! I need them for my magic to work right this time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: With these seven-spotted ladybugs and a seven-pointed magic circle, I just know it's gonna work!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …I understand the urge to rely upon ladybugs.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I did the very same when my father taught me that they were symbols of luck.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I used to beg for ladybug-shaped cakes and polish the ladybug charms affixed to my Schulranzen—my schoolbag…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But in the end, I realized that they were merely a symbol.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My father taught me that while ladybugs can provide a morale boost, only I can control my own life.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If there is something I want to achieve, I must do so with my own efforts. On that note…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let me ask you something. Can you truly feel joy towards an achievement that isn't yours?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Urgh… Nnngh…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay, fine! I'll give them back if you want 'em so bad! I'll make the magic work all by myself!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: All's well that ends well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The situation was resolved five minutes, fifty-three seconds earlier than anticipated. Your assistance proved invaluable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: By the way…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Would you be interested in joining the Ladybug Management Association?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Your willingness to drop everything and take action for the sake of ladybugs is an admirable trait.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Having someone like you among our ranks would be of great help. Of course, I'll ensure none of our ladybug activities affect my training.
choice_data_list: I don't know if I have the energy…
If you really think I can help, sure!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …I understand. Taking on another job in addition to your current duties as a trainer would certainly be tiring.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We can begin with building up your educational background on ladybugs, then.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Aller Anfang ist schwer—all beginnings are difficult. However, once you start, a whole new world will become yours.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: After we've built up your knowledge of them, we will begin training you to run at thirty kilometers per hour, the same speed that ladybugs can fly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Have no fear. Ladybugs tend to favor a specific locale, so their migration paths are rather short—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't bring myself to stop her with how excited she looks while rattling off ladybug facts… so I end up listening to her lectures on a regular basis.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But of course. I will inform the other members at once.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oho? Interested in joining this association, are you? You have good taste.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ladybugs are beneficial insects that protect fields and flowerbeds day and night.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Therefore, protecting them is a vital part of protecting the academy as a whole.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let's do our utmost for the academy and for the ladybugs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From that point on, I join Eishin Flash on regular patrols around the campus to check on the ladybugs.
